races.paceDynamic: Ka Mate Du Brivet will lead uncontested with Broomfield Aderra tracking in second, setting up a tactical affair over this staying trip. scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Ka Mate Du Brivet gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The leader dictates throughout and has enough left to repel challenges up the hill. Broomfield Aderra stays on but can't match the winner's tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Broomfield Aderra gets the perfect stalking position behind the leader
scenarios.body: The good going suits Broomfield Aderra's style perfectly and superior recent form tells. Ka Mate Du Brivet weakens in the final furlong after doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and Willshebe Court gets cover
scenarios.body: The slow pace negates the front runners' advantage and allows the hold-up horse to unleash a telling late challenge. Willshebe Court's stamina proves decisive on the long run-in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Decides
scenarios.trigger: If poor jumping or mistakes disrupt the tactical battle
scenarios.body: Errors at crucial hurdles change the complexion completely with the most fluent jumper capitalizing. The small field means any mistake gets severely punished.

races.paceDynamic: Motazzen will dictate from the front with minimal early pressure, creating a sustainable gallop that should see the field well-strung out turning for home. scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Motazzen Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Motazzen jumps cleanly and maintains his rhythm without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner builds a decisive advantage turning in and holds off late challenges. His proven stamina over this trip and style advantage in a thin pace battle sees him home.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Comeback
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and Motazzen ties up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Geordies Betty and Godot find their preferred strong pace scenario as the leaders weaken. The hold-up specialists time their runs perfectly as fitness tells late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Peking Opera or Vendant can get closer to Motazzen than usual and quicken
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid getting too far behind the leader and produce sharp acceleration when it matters. Their tactical positioning proves superior to both front-running and hold-up styles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improving Kylenoe Dancer
scenarios.trigger: If Kylenoe Dancer finds significant improvement from his recent Goodwood win
scenarios.body: The progressive sort builds on recent success with a career-best performance that sees him outstay rivals. His upward trajectory continues against this modest field.
